title: Tsallis diversity profiles
description: Tsallis generalised entropy for each sample over a range of q orders.

sample_dim.title: Sample dimension
sample_dim.description: Name of the sample dimension of the abundance matrix.

taxon_dim.title: Taxon dimension
taxon_dim.description: Name of the taxon dimension of the abundance matrix.

scales.title: Q scales
scales.description: Tsallis q orders to evaluate; 0 gives richness minus one, 1 gives Shannon entropy.

norm.title: Normalise by richness
norm.description: Divide each profile by its maximum attainable value for the observed richness, as vegan tsallis norm=TRUE.

hill.title: Hill numbers
hill.description: Convert the profiles to Hill numbers; cannot be combined with norm.
